# Common six-digit secret codes rejected by both clients (docs/PROTOCOL.md §5.2):
# frequent PINs from published PIN studies, repeated blocks (121212, 123123,
# 112233, 111222), mirrored codes (123321) and keypad shapes (147258, 159753,
# 102030). Codes made of one digit (000000) or a run up or down the digits
# (123456, 890123, 654321) are rejected by their own rules and are not listed.
# Dates (e.g. 200590) are deliberately allowed.
# Every entry is exactly six ASCII digits. Keep sorted, one per line.
